svg.title: Tin & Thyme
svg.desc: The Tin & Thyme banner: a copper galley porthole with Basil, the Head Chef robot, looking out of it and a thyme sprig along the rim; the pixel wordmark TIN & THYME; the line Pathfinder runs the round; Tin & Thyme lets you watch the kitchen; three robots of the crew on a galley counter; and the plate A Wonder Wagon tool · by Lamadrid Labs.
